question: WEkEO free account offers two distinct storage figures: up to 20 GB in the JupyterHub home directory and up to 8 GB of WEkEO Drive file storage/sharing. Does a single per-account storage quota apply, or are these separate pools that could be combined for bulk storage?
why: The free-account features page states the 20 GB JupyterHub and 8 GB Drive figures separately; whether they are additive or a single quota needs an account or a first-party statement.
